card.name: Start of animal names like rats, raptors
card.fires_on: The letter r (or R) that begins an animal name such as rats, raptors, raccoons, rhesus or raven, mostly where animals are being listed. It comes right after a word like 'in', 'for', or a dose figure for animal studies.

modes.label: Animal studies
modes.description: Capital R opening 'Rats' after a dose or species list in toxicity data.

modes.label: Wildlife text
modes.description: Lowercase r starting a bird or animal name in nature writing.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward animal-count words like 'one', 'two' or 'this' followed by an animal, such as 'ducks', 'cats' or 'fox'.
card.plain: It notices the first letter of an animal name like rats or raptors and gets ready for an animal word.
